why: Heap-top seed, MAIN image: sole provenance site for ALL FIVE above-16m corridors (c1-c5, docs/kb/cart-streaming-map.md). FUN_8c085b00 (system init) creates the game's single syMalloc-family heap as [0x8c1de200, TOP) where TOP=0x8e000000 (Naomi 32MB RAM top) is materialized by 'or #0x8e,r0; shll16 r0; shll8 r0' at P1 0x8c085b50-0x8c085b54. This word = the 16-bit insns 0xcb8e ('or #0x8e,r0') + 0x4028 ('shll16 r0'); patching 0xcb8e -> 0xcb8d makes TOP=0x8d000000 (DC 16MB top). The live allocator is a tail-carving first-fit (FUN_8c06fe80, 0x8c06fe80-0x8c06ff0f: shrinks the free node and carves the new block from its top end; all address math node-relative), so the identical allocation sequence shifts every buffer down exactly 0x1000000: c1 0x0d244c20-0x0dd73e00 -> 0x0c244c20-0x0cd73e00, c2 -> 0x0cd7d020-0x0cd92020, c3 -> 0x0cdc2960-0x0cde3960, c4 (hot ring) -> 0x0ce4dbe0-0x0ce8b480, c5 (GDFS bounce buffer) -> 0x0cfe6d20-0x0cfe7520. Low 24 bits of every allocation are preserved (shift is 16MB-aligned). See docs/kb/relocation-map.md §Provenance.

Heap-top seed, TEST image: the .dat's second program (Test load entry, ROM 0x171ff8 -> RAM 0x8c020000, 0x4dc40 B, docs/kb/game.md §Parsed .dat header) carries a verbatim copy of the same heap-create function (180-byte identical run: dat 0x1af844-0x1af8f8 == dat 0x65b00-0x65bb4) with its own 'or #0x8e,r0; shll16' word at test-RAM 0x8c05d89c. An idiom sweep over the whole test image finds exactly this one seed. Same one-halfword change as the main-image entry, so test mode runs against the same 16MB heap top instead of producing above-16m dests that would falsely indict the main patch.

VRAM-size seed, MAIN image (dat_offset = P1 - 0x8c020000; P1 0x8c03203c). kmInitDevice = FUN_8c031fee (KAMUI2, NEC): stores device word (arg & [0x8c03202c]=0xffff0000) at state 0x8c19e4bc, then sets state+0x7f8 = total VRAM size ('mov.w 0x8c0320e0'=0x7f8; store in the jsr delay slot at 0x8c032048): device == [0x8c032038]=0x00010000 (Naomi, the value senkosp passes via [0x8c03d598]) -> size = [0x8c03203c] = 0x01000000 (16MB, THIS word); any other device -> [0x8c0320ec] = 0x00800000 (8MB, the library's native DC mode). Task 10 had this branch inverted; the Task 10b RAM snapshot (tools/ram-snapshot.bin) shows live state 0x8c19e4bc = 0x00010000 with state+0x7f8 = 0x01000000. Whole-image D-opcode sweep: exactly ONE loader of this pool (0x8c032012) and one of the 8MB pool (0x8c032040); every other 0x01000000 pool word is a comparand/flag/window-length (audit in docs/kb/relocation-map.md). Downstream (the whole above-8m placement): state+0x7f8 is read at exactly two sites - FUN_8c02e300 (display/TA config; passes it into the placement fn 0x8c038aa0, which has explicit dual 16MB/8MB arithmetic: 'cmp/eq 0x1000000' then +0x1000000 or +0x800000 at 0x8c038aec-0x8c038b0c) and the region-base clamp 0x8c031b60 (forces the scan-out region base to size/2 = 0x800000 only under a size==0x1000000 guard). The scan-out FB pair 0x800000/0xc00000 and the above-8m texture arena are all computed from this one cell; the .dat even ships the KAMUI2 config block 0x8c170eb8 with 8MB-mode file defaults (+4 = 0x00800000, runtime-overwritten to 0x01000000 - snapshot diff). Patching 16MB->8MB makes the library configure its native DC 8MB layout: all placements below 0x800000, alignment guaranteed by the library's own 8MB path.

TA-area reservation, MAIN image (P1 0x8c031c14, pool word of FUN_8c031b60 = the KAMUI2 VRAM budget calculator). The fn computes state+0x800 (total TA area, both banks) = vram_size - FB_total - tex_area, where on the 8MB arm the game's 0x900000 texture request overflows and is clamped to tex = vram - FB + THIS constant -- so the constant IS minus the total TA reservation. Stock -0x40000 leaves 128KB per bank: ISP 0x88e0 (35KB) + OPB spill pool 0x2ca0 (11KB); real hardware drops per-tile geometry beyond these budgets (hw-round4: SB_ISTERR bit 0 latched every 3D frame; Flycast enforces no TA limits) = phase-5 missing assets. Round-5 tried -0x180000 (ISP 526,560): geometry fixed, but the 1.25MB arena cost re-opened the T1 texture-arena exhaustion (hw-round5). r8 value -0x11A000 -> per-bank 0x8d000, arena cost 0xda000 (892,928) vs stock. CRITICAL COMPANION: the library's own carve is ispl = olb*3/4 with olb = per_bank - 0x14980 (exact on both known layouts, docs/kb/phase5-hardware.md SS Round 6 prep), which at this T yields ISP 0x5a4e0 = 369,888 -- BELOW the measured Naomi-leg demand max 0x664e0 = 419,040 (captures/phase5/paramhw-naomi.log). This entry therefore REQUIRES the G-CARVE ptr hook (build_patch_table.py -> shim_g_carve), which re-stomps ispl=0x711e0 (463,328, +10% over demand -- operator-accepted razor-thin r8) and oll=0x712e0, leaving the never-consumed OPB spill pool (nopb==nopbi in all 120 RNDREG samples incl. the Naomi arm) at 29,600/bank. Do not ship this constant without that hook.

VRAM-size seed, TEST image (raw .dat offset convention, same as heap entry 2). The test program carries its own kmInitDevice copy at dat 0x183b66 = test-RAM 0x8c031b6e (0x32-byte identical run from entry; the 16MB pool loader 'd20a' at entry+0x24 and the 8MB loader 'd22a' at entry+0x52 are byte-identical to the main copy, and both entries are congruent mod 4 so the PC-relative displacements resolve to the same entry-relative pools: 16MB word at entry+0x4e = dat 0x183bb4 = THIS word, 8MB word at entry+0xfe = dat 0x183c64 = 0x00800000, both byte-verified). Same one-word change so the service/test menu also configures the 8MB VRAM layout.
